grid_context: relative_stats and daily_log_volatility: local DailyGrid bound to the config by SHA-256 (Amendment 1 item 4); intraday_realized_variance: R17 context. daily closes are BAR rows on a daily governed grid with R17 grid and slot-coverage conventions: one slot per governed session, [start_ns,end_ns) session bounds, session_id, grid/calendar identity, target slot and per-slot coverage from the R17 context; one bar per session per role; no DAILY-kind input

mathematics.notation: closes C are positive integer coefficients at one scale; governed slots are indexed 0..t, t the target; K the cutoff; a slot is READY iff its row exists, its close is non-null and positive, its coverage is complete and known_at is non-null and <= K
mathematics.simple_return: r_j = C_j / C_{j-1} - 1 exact rational, defined iff slots j-1 and j are both READY (never across a gap)
mathematics.pair: pair j valid iff r_j(instrument) and r_j(benchmark) are both defined, same governed session id j
mathematics.window: return slots j = t-W+1..t; the window must lie wholly inside the grid (t-W >= 0) else insufficient_history; n = number of valid pairs; available iff n >= min_pairs
mathematics.means: xbar = (1/n) sum x_j, ybar = (1/n) sum y_j over the SAME n valid pairs (x instrument, y benchmark)
mathematics.sums: Sxx = sum (y_j - ybar)^2 (benchmark), Syy = sum (x_j - xbar)^2 (instrument), Sxy = sum (x_j - xbar)(y_j - ybar); exact rationals
mathematics.correlation: rho = Sxy / sqrt(Sxx * Syy) = sign(Sxy) * sqrt(Sxy^2 / (Sxx * Syy)); Sxx == 0 or Syy == 0 -> zero_denominator; exact value lies in [-1, 1]
mathematics.residual: e_t = x_t - beta * y_t with beta above (window includes the target); requires the target pair valid and Sxx > 0
mathematics.denominator_cancellation: cov and var use n-1 (declared); n-1 versus n cancels exactly in beta = cov/var and rho, so no published output depends on the choice
mathematics.daily_log_vol: l_i = ln(C_i / C_{i-1}), i = t-N+1..t from N+1 READY closes; lbar = (1/N) sum l_i; s2 = sum (l_i - lbar)^2 / (N-1); vol = sqrt(A * s2)
mathematics.realized_variance: RV(t) = sum_{i=a+1..t} (ln(C_i / C_{i-1}))^2, bars a..t of the reset epoch, all READY; no mean subtraction; first bar contributes no return
mathematics.rounding: ratios and sums are exact rationals; publication is one float64 rounding of the exact (or Decimal120 reference) value; sqrt and ln are irrational so those fixtures use the R17 tolerance
mathematics.accuracy_requirement: each ln(C_i/C_{i-1}) must be evaluated from the exact ratio with relative error far below 1e-12 even when the ratio is within 1e-15 of 1 (log1p-grade, fixtures DV14, RV16); variance must be centered in a two-pass or exact manner, never E[x^2]-E[x]^2 in float; ln and sqrt reference: Decimal120 correctly rounded, acceptance R17 tolerance (O11)

numeric_policy.reference: exact fractions.Fraction where the value is rational (all relative_stats outputs except correlation of non-square ratios), otherwise Decimal at 120 digits (ln, sqrt); no recurrence exists in these families (windowed sums), so no Decimal120 recurrence fixture is needed

acceptance_rules.bits: bit-identical float64; used ONLY where exactness is argued per fixture: the exact value is representable or zero; +0.0 is REQUIRED for zero (never -0.0); there is no absolute floor in this contract (R17 INTRADAY.md)
acceptance_rules.r17_tol: |x - ref| <= max(8 ulp(ref), 1e-12 * |ref|), the R17 tolerance; abs_tolerance is listed per fixture

numeric_policy.exact_zero_arguments: log returns are exactly 0 iff the close ratio is exactly 1 (decided on integers); rational relative_stats zeros are exact by Fraction arithmetic; equal exact ratios give identical logs so the centered sum is exactly 0 (DV07) and implementations must return +0.0
numeric_policy.correlation_pm1: reference-implementation statement: correlation exactly +1 or -1 is bit-required only through the exact-rational perfect-square path; all other correlations are irrational and use r17_tol

quality.rule: all applicable reasons retained in lexical order; status follows the first applicable reason in precedence; value null iff status is not available

counts.relative_stats: unavailable: expected = window, observed = n valid pairs; AVAILABLE: expected = observed = n usable pairs (QualityRow requires observed == expected for available), n >= min_pairs, so the published row never shows the window length; lost pairs ride in reasons (permitted on an available row) and in excluded evidence rows

counts.intraday_realized_variance: expected = max(2, t - a + 1), observed = READY bars among a..t

quality.independent_readiness: relative_stats: correlation and beta need only n >= min_pairs valid pairs; the residual additionally needs the target pair; a lost target pair with n >= min_pairs leaves correlation and beta available

evidence.limit: config evidence_limit 0..10000 is RESULT-WIDE as FeatureResult bounds it (len(evidence) <= metadata.evidence_limit across all outputs); selecting outputs one at a time reproduces each output's own list (per-output 'witnesses' in the fixtures); a joint selection concatenates the outputs in lexical feature-id order and truncates (field joint_selection_evidence); excluded rows count against the limit and follow the consumed rows of their output
evidence.relative_stats_order: instrument first used close, instrument last used close, benchmark first used close, benchmark last used close (row id slot:<i>, role carried by the input_id)
evidence.intraday_order: anchor slot a then target slot t
evidence.row_id: row_id slot:<i> as emitted by the merged EF2 libraries (packages/intraday _flow.py: EvidenceRow(entity, feature, input_id, f'slot:{i}', ...)); the role is the input_id (instrument or benchmark); fixtures write instrument:slot:i as input:row

quality.lost_slot_reasons: for n < min_pairs, and for daily or intraday windows with holes, reasons are the causes of the lost pairs or slots only; insufficient_history is added ONLY when the window is not wholly inside the grid (RS01, DV01, RV01); on an AVAILABLE relative_stats output those same causes are carried as reasons and excluded evidence rows (existing rows only: null, unknown, future-known, gap; absent slots have no row)

mode_rule: batch and full replay only; known_at and reconstruction availability modes give identical results; update, restore and merge are unsupported (UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY); output at target t is independent of every slot after t (prefix property, PX01 to PX03)
fixture_notation: compact, NOT canonical wire. scale 2 coefficients; K=100; known_at 50 unless stated. Slot states: priced (c, known_at), absent (no row, no coverage), gap (declared incomplete coverage), unknown (known_at null), future (known_at 150 > K), null (row with null close; for BAR volume null and OHLC null), empty (BAR only: volume 0, OHLC null, coverage complete expected 0). relative_stats fixtures: W=window, minp=min_pairs, t target, inst and bench slot lists indexed from 0. daily: N=period, A=annualization_factor. intraday: slot 0 is the session anchor a, A may be null when only the variance is selected, prior_close is the last close of the previous session (informational), grid_slots_declared is the number of governed slots of the session. alternatives_not_published lists counterexample values of rejected conventions; they are NOT contract outputs.

construction_rules.bar: BAR rows with volume > 0 need positive coherent non-null OHLC (INVALID_SCHEMA otherwise). A null-price slot is a row with volume null and OHLC null. A proven-empty slot is volume 0 with OHLC null on a slot whose coverage is complete with expected 0; volume 0 with non-null OHLC is INVALID_SCHEMA. Negative volume BOUNDS. Absent slot: no row and no coverage. Gap: coverage declared incomplete.
construction_rules.reset_epoch_only: the epoch is the target session from its first governed bar; prior-session bars may be present in the role but never enter the epoch
construction_rules.bar_daily_close_only: close-only BAR batch on the daily governed grid (required_fields close); columns instrument_id, session_id, start_ns, end_ns, close, known_at_ns. A null-close slot is a row with close null (no volume column). Positive closes only: 0 or negative is INVALID_SCHEMA. Identity (instrument, session, start, end) unique: DUPLICATE; start before previous end: INVALID_ORDER.

DP-S1.decision: relative_stats consumes two DAILY close-only roles (instrument, benchmark); the library derives returns from exact integer closes; the 'return witness' is the pair of adjacent closes with their row ids as evidence
DP-S1.alternatives: float64 return series (rounded, not exact), REFERENCE return rows, existing ReturnReference scalars (one horizon only, cannot form a series)

DP-S2.decision: return basis for EQ-153: simple session return C_j/C_{j-1}-1 (consistent with relative.market_return and history.return; exact rational arithmetic)
DP-S2.alternatives: natural log returns (would need a new policy label ef3-rel2 and Decimal references), excess over a risk-free series (needs another role)

DP-S3.decision: one return per two adjacent governed closes; a return spanning a missing close is never formed
DP-S3.alternatives: multi-session spanning return across the hole (mixes horizons), forward fill (invents a zero return)

DP-S4.decision: sample population: the last W governed return slots ending at the target (inclusive); complete-case pairing: only slots where both returns are defined enter, and means are joint means
DP-S4.alternatives: strict only (all W pairs), per-series own means, target excluded (prior-only), calendar-day windows

DP-S5.decision: minimum coverage: caller min_pairs in 2..W, no default, n >= min_pairs available, W = min_pairs reproduces strict mode; the window must lie wholly inside the grid (else insufficient_history regardless of min_pairs)
DP-S5.alternatives: min_pairs fixed by policy, fraction-of-window threshold, lower bound 3 (OPEN OQ10)

DP-S6.decision: covariance is centered (OLS with intercept) with the sample denominator n-1 declared; because beta and correlation are ratios the denominator cancels exactly and no output depends on it
DP-S6.alternatives: population denominator n (identical outputs), uncentered regression through the origin (different beta, shown in RS02 and RS18)

DP-S7.decision: zero variance is an exact rational zero test with no epsilon. Zero benchmark variance: correlation, beta and residual are not_applicable/zero_denominator. Zero instrument variance only: correlation zero_denominator, beta exactly 0, residual equals the instrument target return
DP-S7.alternatives: define beta=0 or rho=0 for degenerate cases, epsilon threshold, nonfinite output

DP-S8.decision: beta-adjusted residual e_t = r_i,t - beta * r_b,t, beta from the same window including the target, no intercept, requires the target pair
DP-S8.alternatives: prior-only beta (window ending t-1), intercept-adjusted residual r - alpha - beta*r_b (values in RS02 and RS18 alternatives), residual on log basis

DP-S9.decision: benchmark identity: exactly one benchmark named by config benchmark_id; same namespace, grid, scale, currency and adjustment declaration as the instrument; no FX, no rescaling, no hidden benchmark; any third instrument is a typed refusal
DP-S9.alternatives: scale-free returns allowing different units (OPEN OQ4)

DP-S10.decision: exact rational arithmetic with one float64 rounding; correlation is the correctly rounded exact real sign*sqrt(Sxy^2/(Sxx*Syy)), within the R17 tolerance; the published value never leaves [-1,1]

DP-V1.decision: daily volatility uses natural-log close ratios, centered, sample N-1, vol = sqrt(A * variance), as a NEW feature id history.log_return_volatility; the existing history.return_volatility (simple returns) is unchanged and distinct (DV15 shows different values for the same closes)
DP-V1.alternatives: population denominator N, uncentered RMS (both shown in DV15 alternatives), a version flag on the existing id (rejected: silent change of an accepted API)

DP-V2.decision: annualization is the caller integer A (1..2^63-1), no default; vol = sqrt(A * s2); A=1 is explicit unannualized; the policy does not claim A is sessions per year
DP-V2.alternatives: variance annualization A*s2 without sqrt, a calendar-derived factor, fractional A

DP-V3.decision: strict window: N+1 READY consecutive governed closes, no shrinking, no gap spanning; fewer slots in the grid is insufficient_history
DP-V3.alternatives: min coverage as in relative_stats, bridging returns

DP-R1.decision: realized variance is the uncentered sum of squared log returns of consecutive governed-slot closes in the target session
DP-R1.alternatives: centered sum, bipower or jump-robust variation, subsampled or two-scale estimators

DP-R2.decision: sampling is every governed slot of the supplied grid (the grid version is the sampling frequency); the single-valued sampling parameter makes a coarser step UNSUPPORTED_SAMPLING
DP-R2.alternatives: caller sampling step k (anchoring ambiguity), resampling inside the library

DP-R3.decision: overnight exclusion by the reset epoch: only returns between consecutive bars of the target session; the first bar contributes only its close as base (no open-to-close return, no prior-close return)
DP-R3.alternatives: include first-bar open-to-close, carry epoch including the overnight return (R17 carry; out of v1), separate overnight feature

DP-R4.decision: the governed grid of the session defines the expected slots, so an early-close session simply has fewer slots and is complete at its last slot; no rescaling to a full-day slot count; cross-session comparability is the consumer's responsibility
DP-R4.alternatives: scale by reference_slots/actual_slots, flag early-close sessions

DP-R5.decision: strict completeness from the anchor to the target: no bridging return, no forward fill, no rescaling by expected/observed; a coverage-proven empty slot has no close and yields not_applicable/no_eligible_observations (differs from the money-flow zero-flow rule because a return needs a price)
DP-R5.alternatives: bridging, forward fill (zero return), expected/observed scaling, an allowed fraction of missing bars

DP-R6.decision: minimum of one return: t = a is insufficient_history (observed 1, expected 2); RV-to-date at any later governed target is allowed, completeness of the whole session is the caller's choice of target
DP-R6.alternatives: caller min_returns parameter, session-complete flag (OPEN OQ7)

DP-R7.decision: realized_variance is unannualized; realized_volatility = sqrt(A * RV) with A required exactly when it is selected
DP-R7.alternatives: annualize the variance too, sessions-per-year inferred from the calendar

DP-R8.decision: positive prices only (zero or negative close is INVALID_SCHEMA by the shared validator); units use 'fraction' for dimensionless outputs; no new unit string is introduced (OPEN OQ2)
DP-R8.alternatives: new units for variance and beta

layer_responsibilities.library: admission of supplied closes, alignment and pair validity, returns, windowed sums, beta, correlation, residual, log volatility and realized variance with the stated exactness and accuracy, quality, evidence and every refusal; pure and deterministic; shared per-pair preparation reused by the three relative outputs without coupling their readiness; no acquisition, clock, I/O, calendar lookup or sorting
layer_responsibilities.ef3_io_611: maps ordered closes with known_at into the BAR roles exactly as supplied, the daily governed grid and coverage into the R17 context, the single benchmark identity into config; maps results (float64 hex-exact values, status, reasons, counts, witnesses) to the sink conversion; never derives a return, fills or interpolates a missing close, picks a benchmark, normalizes scale, currency or adjustment, injects a default window, minimum, annualization or threshold
layer_responsibilities.worker_612: routes selected outputs with exact warm-up closure, shares per-pair preparation within resource bounds, executes one config per complete result, binds inputs and the config digest, persists the library result unchanged; direct, worker and stored results identical including refusal class

non_goals: no acquisition of prices, benchmarks, calendars or session schedules; no benchmark selection or universe join beyond the one requested pair
no sector or market construction; no multi-factor or multi-benchmark regression; no rolling-state, update, restore or merge capability
no carry epoch; no overnight or open-to-close return features; no jump-robust, bipower, two-scale or subsampled realized measures
no default window, minimum coverage, annualization or threshold; no annual-risk claim for any annualization factor
no change to and no interplay with history.return_volatility, relative.market_return, relative.sector_return, ReturnReference or any accepted R17 or EF2 output (distinct producers)
no new DataKind, DTO, codec, scheduler, error code, unit string or shared-validator change; no performance, parity, release or publication claim; no private-source equivalence
